title: Philippine Folk dance : Tinikling | Tutorial | FIGURE 1 to 8

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor uses detailed voice-over narration with on-screen text descriptions to break down each figure of the dance. They demonstrate the footwork and counts systematically from a front-facing perspective.

lesson_structure.note: Tinikling Step Right and Left explanation

steps_taught.name: Tinikling Step Right
steps_taught.description: Hop on left foot outside bamboo, hop on right between poles, hop on left in same spot.

steps_taught.name: Tinikling Step Left
steps_taught.description: Hop on right foot outside bamboo, hop on left between poles, hop on right in same spot.

steps_taught.name: Kuradang Step
steps_taught.description: Change step forward right, step left across right in front.

what_works: Clear on-screen text labels for counts, steps, and dancer roles.
Demonstration matches the narrated instructions step by step.
what_hinders: Lack of live verbal instruction or breakdown slows down learning pace.
No back or side angle demonstrations provided.

quotes.text: Hop on left foot outside the bamboos count one.
Hop on the right between the bamboo poles count two.
Starting with the right foot dancers take four walk steps forward.
Take seven tinikling steps right and left alternately.

evidence_segments.observation: Two dancers demonstrate footwork with pole placement labeled on screen

extraction.distinctive_method: Combining textbook-style numbered figures with instructional voice-over and on-screen text overlays for traditional Philippine folk dances.
